 The Thunder have lost their last three games, and an experienced big man will try and turn the tables for OKC when they face the Kings.
 Best Bet
 LA Lakers @ Phoenix Suns (8:10am)
 Walker Kessler 
 Over 13.5 Points 
 Bet Now 
 $1.83 
 No Austin Reaves for the Lakers which should result in some additional touches for Walker Kessler.
 The big man has played one game without Reaves this season, and produced a 21-point performance against the Hawks.
 In his favour is the matchup – the Suns are the third easiest team for big men to score against this season at 14% above average, so up against Ighodara we should see Kessler heavily involved on the offensive end in this.

 Next Best
 Charlotte Hornets @ LA Clippers (8:40am)
 Grayson Allen 
 Over 2.5 3PM 
 Bet Now 
 $1.71 
 Never had any issues shooting the rock, and this situation at Charlotte where they’re shorthanded works perfectly for Grayson.
 As a Hornet, he’s hit 3+ triples in eight of his 12 games this season, and when playing 23+ minutes he’s covered in six of those eight games.
 Allen has hit 3+ threes in five of his last six games – the one miss being a complete blowout against the Celtics. Shouldn’t be like that against the Clippers.

 Value Bet
 OKC Thunder @ Sacramento Kings (1:10pm)
 Isaiah Hartenstein 
 Over 4.5 Assists 
 Bet Now 
 $2.10 
 With Chet and Jalen Williams out for the Thunder, Hartenstein has been monstrous in their absence.
 Hartenstein is averaging 4.4 assists per game without the duo this season, but it’s his recent form which has been most promising.
 In his last five games, iHart is averaging six assists per game, hitting 5+ assists in all five games while hitting 6+ ($3.32) in four of those games. Expect Hartenstein’s role in this OKC offensive to continue while Chet is sidelined.
